description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* 1 mile to Beach Highlands Neighborhood Beach Access* Amazing Outdoor Space– Enjoy your morning coffee or evening drinks bug-free on the screened-in porch while taking in the peaceful outdoor setting.* 4 Bikes Included*Resort Style Infinity Pool (seasonally heated) overlooking Gulf and Topsail State Park*This home is just steps away from the second community pool* Pet Friendly (Approval and Additional Fees Apply)*Coveted Gated Community that includes Jetted Spa, Tennis Courts, Nature Trails, Fitness Center, Outdoor Fireplace* Snorkel the Seahorse Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp, Grand Blvd, and Gulf Place * Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *Wristbands need to be worn at the Pool, Tennis Courts, and Clubhouse and Guests will be charged $100 for each lost Wristband.*Come to Dreamy Afterdune on 30A, a gorgeous 4 bedroom, 4 bath, home in the luxury community of Cypress Dunes. You will love watching the sunset from the porch that's surrounded by nature. Create a home-cooked meal in the professional-grade kitchen. Enjoy sitting and relaxing around the fireplace after a fun day at the beach. With a king bed in the Master Suite on the first floor, a king guest bedroom, a queen guest bedroom, and a bedroom with 2 XL Twin beds on 2nd floor, this lovely beach home sleeps 8 guests comfortably. Enjoy the sparkling community pool, get some fun exercise at the tennis courts, or take a stroll through the nature trails. Make Dreamy Afterdune your next place to relax and unwind!Along the west of 30A you’ll find the luxury gated community that is Cypress Dunes. Here begins the 18-mile bike path that stretches to Rosemary Beach. You will love neighborhood amenities here that include gulf views from the infinity-edged swimming pool (seasonally heated for spring and fall school breaks and the holidays), outdoor fireplace, large hot tub, fitness center, and a second-level sundeck overlooking the Gulf and Coastal Dunes Lake. Stroll along the wooden boardwalk and nature trails, have a picnic on the expansive recreational lawn area, or get your game on at the tennis courts. For luxury and convenience, Cypress Dunes truly has something for everyone!Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 3: 2 XL Twin BedsArea Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Seahorse Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 715 feet from the Topsail Hill Preserve State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Seahorse Reef is at a depth of 13-18 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
